'''Qingning''' is an NPC in [[Huanglong]]. She guards the western entrance to Jinzhou with [[Heguang]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Qingning:''' When they say, "Make the most of the land, and the people's wisdom will follow," they've gotta be talking about this impressive high wall in Jinzhou.
:'''Qingning:''' I heard the creation of this wall was a lucky accident. The byproducts from processing [[Tacetite]] weapons turned out to be ideal for defense.
:'''Qingning:''' It's ideal for building strong and stable defense structures.
:'''Qingning:''' The land was used to its fullest, and everyone did their part. Together, we built Jinzhou brick by brick with our skills.
:'''Qingning:''' I think it's not only the high wall that keeps Jinzhou safe, but all of us who stand behind it.
:'''Qingning:''' Thinking about this makes the dullness and weariness of guarding the gate fade away.
{{Dialogue End}}
